name: Singapore
title: Singapore's Rationed Hub

bars: Awarded in Singapore's two calls for application, 2023 and 2026

tagline: The region's network hub, rationing power since 2019. Its overflow helped build Johor and Batam, and almost all its power fuel is imported.
srcNote: Main data: Singapore's Energy Market Authority (EMA), IMDA, EDB and MDDI, with company releases and press.
